headline: Names a federal courthouse in Durham, North Carolina, after John Hervey Wheeler.
what_it_does: This law officially names the U.S. courthouse at 323 East Chapel Hill Street in Durham, North Carolina, the John Hervey Wheeler United States Courthouse. The name applies while the building is used as a federal courthouse. It is an honorary designation and does not change how the court operates.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on January 3, 2019.
